name: aura-chart
description: IG DAX candlestick chart — React + CandleKit + Lightweight Charts frontend with a Hono + TypeScript backend proxying the IG Markets REST API.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,ui -c blue,green "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run typecheck
